claim: Maison Moizeau is the lodging arm of La Marine: 5 rooms (Lutins, Blanche, Jean, Madeleine, Clère) at 7 Rue Marie Lemonnier, harbour views except Lutins, prices €180–€275, breakfast €25/pers.
quote: 5 cosy rooms: Lutins, Blanche, Jean, Madeleine, Clère ... Lutins: €180 ... Blanche, Jean: €250 ... Madeleine, Clère: €275

claim: Couillon's establishment is positioned as a '3 Michelin Star Restaurant & Hotel' at 3 Rue Marie Lemonnier, 85330 Noirmoutier-en-l'Île; bookings via contact@alexandrecouillon.com / +33 2 51 39 23 09.
quote: 3 Michelin Star Restaurant & Hotel ... 3 Rue Marie Lemonnier, 85330 Noirmoutier-en-l'Île

claim: La Marine is part of Relais & Châteaux.
quote: La Marine Restaurant | Fine dining restaurant Noirmoutier-en-l'île | Relais & Châteaux

claim: La Marine retained its three Michelin stars in the 2026 guide; Couillon first earned a third star in 2023.
quote: Guide Michelin 2026 : le restaurant La Marine à Noirmoutier conserve ses trois étoiles

claim: La Marine sits in L'Herbaudière; dinner service Wednesday–Saturday, 7:15–8:15 pm seating window; tasting menus €240–€350.
quote: Wednesday to Saturday from 7:15–8:15pm for dinner ... menus range from €240 to €350

claim: Taxi L'Herbaudière → Noirmoutier-en-l'Île is roughly 3 miles, ~7–8 minutes, ~$17–21.
quote: Taxi from L'Herbaudière to Noirmoutier-en-l'Île costs $17-$21 and takes 7 minutes ... distance ... 3 miles

claim: Six taxi/VTC operators serve Noirmoutier; only Taxi Fred (+33 2 51 39 37 31) is explicitly listed as 7 days/7 — book ahead for post-dinner returns.
quote: Taxi Fred - +33 (0) 2 51 39 37 31 (listed as '7 days/7')

claim: Hôtel Bord à Bord sits on the L'Herbaudière fishing/marina port — walking distance to La Marine — with double rooms €80 low season to €165 family-room high season, port and sea views.
quote: located on the fishing harbour and marina, with restaurants, bars, and shops all within walking distance ... from €80 (low season) to €165 (high season)

claim: Hôtel Bord à Bord rooms start at €85 (double) and €105 (family for 2–6); selling point is the panoramic port/sea view from rooms and breakfast room.
quote: double rooms accommodating 2 people starting at €85, and family rooms for 2-6 people from €105

claim: Bord à Bord reviews are mixed: guests praise location, sea views and breakfast but flag dated bedding/bathrooms.
quote: the hotel being somewhat dated, with concerns about worn bedding and bathrooms needing renovation

claim: La Chambre d'Emilie is a chambres d'hôtes in L'Herbaudière, walking distance to La Marine, from €78/night for two incl. breakfast.
quote: located near the fishing and pleasure port, close to numerous restaurants ranging from fast food to Michelin-starred (la Marine) ... from €78 for one night for two people including breakfast

claim: La Chambre d'Emilie offers a single ~12 m² room with a 140 cm double bed and dedicated bathroom, hosted by Geneviève Boucheron at 10 lot Boissonnelles, L'Herbaudière.
quote: room is approximately 12m² with a view of the garden ... 140 cm bed for 2 people ... Geneviève Boucheron

claim: Villa Arthus-Bertrand is a 4-star, 18-room family mansion nestled in Bois de la Chaise pinewood, with heated outdoor pool, exotic garden, restaurant and concierge; doubles €115–€330 low season.
quote: characterful residence nestled in the heart of the Bois de la Chaise ... 18 carefully appointed rooms and suites ... low season, a double room ranges from €115 to €330

claim: Villa Arthus-Bertrand guest reviews highlight spacious, stylish rooms and tranquil gardens; common complaint is no air-conditioning.
quote: spacious, stylish, and impeccably clean rooms, though some note the absence of air conditioning

claim: Le Général d'Elbée is a 4-star, 25-room hotel & spa in an 18th-century Historical-Monument building on the old port of Noirmoutier-en-l'Île, with NUXE spa, pool and garden; closed 11 Nov – 13 Feb.
quote: building erected in the heart of the town in the middle of the 18th century ... 25 individually designed rooms ... NUXE spa services ... closes annually from November 11 to February 13

claim: Les Prateaux is a 3-star Relais du Silence in Bois de la Chaise with a 3,700 m² park, large bright rooms and on-site gourmet restaurant; open 20 Mar – 17 Oct 2026 only, restaurant closed Wednesdays.
quote: 3,700 m² park with a seaside feel ... open every evening (except Wednesday) from March 20, 2026 to October 17, 2026

claim: Hôtel L'Île Ô Château has 23 renovated rooms facing the castle and old marina of Noirmoutier-en-l'Île, with a heated pool, poolside bar and bike rental; doubles from ~€78.
quote: 23 renovated rooms, a heated pool, bike rentals, and a buffet breakfast

claim: Hôtel Autre Mer is a 2-star, fully renovated 27-room hotel in Noirmoutier-en-l'Île centre with dune/marram-grass/wood decor and on-site bike rental.
quote: 27 welcoming rooms ... inspired by the island's natural environment with tones of dunes, marram grass, and wood

claim: Hôtel Saint-Paul, a 3-star in Bois de la Chaise, has 35 rooms, indoor/outdoor heated pool, spa with hammam and balneo, and a bistronomic restaurant L'Anse Rouge; rates from €162.
quote: Hôtel Saint Paul ... 35 bedrooms ... indoor/outdoor heated swimming pool ... rates from €162

claim: Maison Moizeau is also listed as the Relais & Châteaux hotel arm of La Marine in Noirmoutier.
quote: La Marine hotel | Luxury hotel Noirmoutier-en-l'île | Relais & Châteaux
